text: Added canonical ScalaFIM migration guide and executable removal audit scripts/verify-image-unification.mjs. Audit scanned 1,085 Scala files and currently reports 93 raw .values.data accesses plus legacy NDArray, NeuroImage, and NeuroImageView owners; required Sampled dense, rank-2 Ravel sparse, and typed support markers are present. PRD, build-graph, and symbol-ownership gates remain green. This is progress evidence only; ScalaFIM compile/test and immutable-consumer receipts remain required.
